label: Line 16: total gain
description: Schedule D (2025) Part III line 16 equals line 7 plus line 15. It is blocked while a recorded Form 1099-B statement has no box 7 answer, and when box 7 is checked and a sale on that statement is at a loss.

published_value.explain: A current derived finding publishes line 16 equal to line 7 plus line 15.

computed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 16 is zero because lines 7 and 15 add to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: You said you have no capital gain or loss, so Schedule D line 16 is zero.

blocked.explain: Schedule D line 16 has no value yet because one of these is true: line 7 or line 15 is not ready, a sale count this line requires is not ready, a recorded Form 1099-B statement has no box 7 answer, or box 7 is checked and a sale on that statement is at a loss. This return does not compute a disallowed loss. Where that loss is the cause, the result changes if the broker reports the loss on a separate statement, or if box 7 is not checked.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No line 16 value exists for this route.
